posts.title: Can Cummins remain as Australia captain?
posts.description: Is the noise around sandpapergate getting too much for Pat Cummins to continue? Henry Moeran speaks to Wisden editor Lawrence Booth & CODE Sports chief cricker writer in the media centre of the MCG to discuss whether the scandal has brought Cummins' position as skipper into question. Plus, Harry Brook speaks to Henry ahead of the first of five T20 matches against Australia at the MCG.
